APIs for NUMA-aware shared memory join, create, query, and page allocation.

# Purpose
This header file defines the public API for `fd_shmem`, which manages shared memory regions with NUMA and page-size awareness. It declares constants, types, and functions for joining and leaving named regions, querying active joins, creating and updating shared memory, allocating and releasing raw pages, and converting between page-size strings and values. The file also exposes NUMA topology helpers and validation routines so code can place memory near a target CPU. In addition, it provides iteration over current joins and internal boot and halt hooks used by the shared memory subsystem.
